hook.label: Swecha · Corpus Volunteer Compute
hook.big: The cluster is already _in the room._
hook.sub: Idle laptops, one shared AI computer for Telugu
hook.say: What if the computers that build A I for Telugu were already on our desks? Swecha's Corpus Volunteer Compute turns idle laptops into one shared A I computer.

beats.label: 01 · Pilot
beats.sub: Telugu audio transcribed · book pages OCR'd
beats.say: In the pilot, volunteers' laptops transcribed {50,000|fifty thousand} hours of Telugu audio, and read {80,000|eighty thousand} book pages with O C R.

beats.label: 02 · Green
beats.sub: The greenest compute is already switched on
beats.say: It needed no new servers, no new cooling, and no new always-on power demand.

beats.label: 03 · Access
beats.say: Telugu has {81|eighty-one} million first-language speakers, but G P Us are rationed and rented. Inference does not need a G P U. It runs on the C P Us and N P Us people already own.

beats.label: 04 · Protocol
beats.sub: Lease a record · compute locally · return only text
beats.say: One server holds the queue. A device claims a record, runs the model locally, and sends back only the text. Devices never talk to each other.

beats.label: 05 · Session
beats.sub: The audio never stays on the volunteer's machine
beats.say: The audio is deleted as soon as the text is safe. If a laptop leaves, its claim expires, and the next volunteer picks the record up.

beats.label: 06 · Guard
beats.sub: Battery, heat and memory, re-checked every 30 seconds
beats.say: A guard checks battery, heat and memory every {30|thirty} seconds, and throttles, so the volunteer's machine stays usable.

beats.label: 07 · Models
beats.say: Audio and its transcripts train Gonthuka, a Telugu speech model. The O C R text trains a Telugu tokenizer, and Nanochat, a {560|five hundred and sixty} million parameter language model.

beats.label: 08 · Scale-up
beats.sub: 20× the audio · 137× the pages · same volunteer fabric
beats.say: Next: one million hours of audio, and eleven million pages, on the same volunteer fabric.

beats.label: 09 · Public infrastructure
beats.big: Made by the people. _Held in common._
beats.sub: Corpus, client and models under AGPL-3.0
beats.say: The corpus, the client and the models are all released under the A G P L licence: public infrastructure, held in common.

beats.label: 10 · Join
beats.sub: Install the client, log in, start volunteering
beats.say: To join, install the corpus client, log in, and start volunteer compute.

outro: Corpus Volunteer Compute, by Swecha. The cluster is already in the room.
